# nemau load-balancer instance create

Create a load balancer.

--flavor picks the tier (see "nemau lb flavors"): lb-small is one appliance and
the default; lb-ha, lb-medium and lb-large run two appliances on two hosts,
active and standby behind the same VIP. The tier cannot be changed afterwards.

Every new load balancer runs in automatic mode and accepts HTTP, HTTPS, TCP and
UDP listeners side by side.

Members receive traffic from the appliances' own addresses. On a
high-availability tier their security groups must admit both appliances
("nemau lb instance get" lists their addresses).

## Usage

```
nemau load-balancer instance create <name> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --description string   free-form description
      --flavor string        tier: lb-small (default), lb-ha, lb-medium, lb-large
      --vip-subnet string    subnet to allocate the VIP in (required)
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
